events.title: BunnyGalSanta releases on December 24
events.summary: We're now publishing games by a new developer, SDT. The first one is BunnyGalSanta. It's a close-contact 3D simulation where you spend Christmas night with a girl in a bunny Santa outfit. The Neji-komi series is known for letting you control the thrusting in real time with your mouse stroke. BunnyGalSanta brings that system into 3D as the "Guru-Guru Piston System". Raise her satisfaction and new positions unlock. She's a Santa, so of course it launches on December 24. A wishlist helps us a lot.
